title: nessie scan record
description: One scan's summary: its names, server preferences, counts and scanner version. Draft (2026-11-23), schema version 1.

schema_version.description: Counted per kind. A reader refuses a version it doesn't know.

server_preferences.description: Every ServerPreferences preference, name to value, verbatim (plugin_set included). PluginsPreferences and the family and Nessus plugin selection are not emitted.

results.description: Result counts by raw severity, keyed "0" to "4", plus total.

nessus_version.description: From the first Nessus plugin 19506 Result's 'Nessus version :' line; absent without one. The one exception to parsing plugin_output.

feed_version.description: From the same Result's 'Plugin feed version :' line.
